title: SOURCE_TARGETS: BR storewatch must notify reboot after same-second Offline->Up restart

payload.user_symptom: BR backup/restore watchers can miss a TiKV store reboot/recovery notification if the store goes Offline then Up again while the PD/TiKV StartTimestamp token remains in the same Unix second; backup retry policy or restore recovery may continue without the expected all-store retry/recovery signal.
payload.validation_scope: unit-level watcher sequence using the existing storewatch callback contract; live TiKV restart frequency is not measured

provenance.source: current source-targets pass with identity-token async filter

state_model: Watcher.Step reads current live stores from PD and keeps lastStores by store ID
updateStore fires OnNewStoreRegistered for first observation
updateStore fires OnDisconnect for Up -> Offline
updateStore originally fired OnReboot only when StartTimestamp changed
BR backup ObserveStoreChangesAsync turns OnReboot and OnDisconnect into send-all retry policy
BR restore SpawnTiKVShutDownWatchers records reboot stores to regenerate leaders
external_token_source: PD server code uses time.Now().Unix() for server start timestamp; Store.StartTimestamp is an int64 seconds-level lifecycle token in metapb.Store
storewatch tests already model reboot by StartTimestamp changing from 1 to 2 after Up->Offline->Up
side_effects: missed BackupRetryPolicy send-all after store restart
missed restore recovery leader regeneration after store reboot
watcher state continues to treat the store as observed without reboot callback

provenance.source: storewatch source and callback consumer inspection

name: BR storewatch must notify reboot after Offline->Up even when StartTimestamp token collides

payload.p_check: updateStore observes the same store ID again and checks whether StartTimestamp changed.
payload.q_claim: unchanged StartTimestamp proves there was no reboot/recovery event requiring OnReboot.
payload.fault: Store StartTimestamp is a seconds-level lifecycle token; a rapid store restart or recovery can return Up with the same StartTimestamp value after an Offline observation.

boundary.before: store ID 1 is observed Up with StartTimestamp T
boundary.fault: same store is observed Offline, then Up again with StartTimestamp T
boundary.after: BR storewatch decides whether to call OnReboot for backup/restore recovery users

source_anchors: br/pkg/utils/storewatch/watching.go updateStore stores lastStores by store ID and originally called OnReboot only on StartTimestamp inequality
br/pkg/utils/storewatch/watching_test.go TestOnReboot defines Up->Offline->Up plus changed StartTimestamp as reboot
br/pkg/backup/store.go ObserveStoreChangesAsync sets sendAll=true on OnReboot
br/pkg/restore/data/data.go SpawnTiKVShutDownWatchers records reboot stores on OnReboot
payload.method_class: identity-token async filter: a coarse lifecycle token was used as the only reboot proof even though state transition also indicates lifecycle recovery

name: BR storewatch notifies reboot when a store returns Up after Offline

payload.contract: After a known store transitions from Up to Offline and then back to Up, storewatch must call OnReboot for BR recovery users even when the seconds-level StartTimestamp token did not change.
minimal_observation: feed watcher a sequence: Up(T), Offline(T), Up(T) for the same store ID
RED if OnReboot callback is not called
GREEN if OnReboot is called while existing OnRegister, OnOffline, and changed-StartTimestamp reboot tests still pass

red_signature.evidence: Up->Offline->Up with the same second-level StartTimestamp did not notify reboot/recovery users

blind_spots: unit test does not measure how often real TiKV restarts collide within one second
the fix intentionally treats Offline->Up as a recovery/reboot notification even if StartTimestamp is unchanged; this is conservative for BR recovery users

name: Store goes Offline then Up with same second-level StartTimestamp

trigger_condition.phase: after watcher has recorded a store as Up
trigger_condition.fault: same store is observed Offline and then Up again before the StartTimestamp token changes

observe: OnReboot fires on Offline->Up even if StartTimestamp is unchanged
backup/restore consumers receive the conservative recovery signal
payload.red_signature: current updateStore skips OnReboot when StartTimestamp is unchanged
payload.green_signature: local fix also treats non-Up -> Up transition as OnReboot

rationale: the bug is a lifecycle token equality filter that used StartTimestamp alone to prove no reboot
the general lifecycle-token oracle is sharpened into a storewatch callback contract
the narrow oracle checks the callback that BR backup/restore consumers rely on
watcher state from the old store lifecycle overlaps the new Up observation
the test forces lifecycle renewal inside the same token value
the fault is the same store returning Up with an unchanged seconds-level start token

source_anchors: br/pkg/utils/storewatch/watching.go updateStore calls OnReboot only if StartTimestamp changes
br/pkg/backup/store.go OnReboot sets sendAll=true for backup retry policy
br/pkg/restore/data/data.go OnReboot records reboot stores for leader recovery

environment.note: command did not use pipefail, so shell exit status followed tee; the log contains the failing test evidence

evidence.oracle: Up->Offline->Up for the same store must notify reboot/recovery users even if seconds-level StartTimestamp collides
evidence.red_observation: OnReboot callback was not called for Up(T)->Offline(T)->Up(T)

lessons.selector_worked: IDENTITY_TOKEN_ASYNC_FILTER found a second current bug candidate after the DDL ownerTS case.
lessons.why_br_registry_screen_helped: BR registry heartbeat had token equality but no product-feasible same-second stale window; storewatch had a direct Offline->Up lifecycle transition that made the same-token schedule meaningful.
lessons.method_note: G3 collision schedule must be proven from product state transitions, not only from token precision.

source_anchors: br/pkg/utils/storewatch/watching.go local fix calls OnReboot when StartTimestamp changes or state returns from non-Up to Up

environment.runner: local current worktree with experimental fix

evidence.oracle: same as RED; Offline->Up same-token recovery must notify OnReboot
evidence.green_observation: full storewatch package passed; existing register/offline/reboot controls still pass

lessons.fix_shape: Preserve old StartTimestamp-change reboot detection and add non-Up -> Up as a conservative recovery/reboot notification.
